summary: SyncTube is a self-hosted platform designed for synchronous video playback and chat with other users, functioning as a simpler alternative to CyTube. It provides a shared virtual room where participants can watch media together in real time. The software is written using Node.js and Haxe and is distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits small groups wanting a straightforward, self-hosted web application to watch videos together without relying on commercial streaming sync services.
watchOut: Development activity is currently slowing down with a low overall maintenance score and no tagged releases, meaning you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack timely security updates.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and manage process lifecycles with a tool like PM2.
